message.content:
Build WhatsApp Integration + AI Rejection Emails for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`.

Read CLAUDE.md first, then read: `src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx`, `src/components/KanbanBoard.tsx`, `src/components/ApplicationsTab.tsx`, `src/pages/Settings.tsx`, `supabase/functions/rewrite-jd/index.ts` (for GPT-4o auth pattern), `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`.

## Feature 1: WhatsApp Integration

### Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260409000000_whatsapp_and_api.sql`
- `ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_number text;`
- Create `whatsapp_templates` table (id, team_id FK, name, body, created_at) with team RLS
- Seed 4 default templates (Interview Invite, Application Update, Document Request, Offer Discussion) for existing teams

### `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppButton.tsx`
- Props: phone, candidateName, jobTitle, size
- If no phone: disabled tooltip "No phone number"
- Cleans phone (strip non-digits except +), generates `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encoded}`
- Green MessageCircle icon button

### `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppDialog.tsx`
- Props: open, onOpenChange, candidatePhone, candidateName, jobTitle, teamId
- Fetches templates from whatsapp_templates table
- Shows template list → click to preview with {{variables}} replaced
- Editable message textarea
- "Open WhatsApp" button → wa.me link
- "Copy Message" fallback button

### Integration
- CandidateDetailSheet: WhatsApp button in action bar (next to Email)
- Settings.tsx: WhatsApp number input field (save to profiles.whatsapp_number)

## Feature 2: AI Rejection Emails

### Edge Function — `supabase/functions/generate-rejection/index.ts`
Copy CORS/auth pattern from rewrite-jd. No credit deduction.
- Input: candidate_name, job_title, strengths[], gaps[], missing_skills[], overall_score
- GPT-4o with json_object format
- System prompt: empathetic HR specialist, specific feedback, encouraging tone
- Output: { subject, body }

### `src/components/candidate/RejectWithFeedbackDialog.tsx`
- Props: open, onOpenChange, candidateName, candidateEmail, jobTitle, result (scores/gaps/strengths), resumeId, jobId, onRejected
- On open: call generate-rejection edge function
- Loading state → show editable subject + body
- "Use simple template" toggle (skip AI)
- "Send & Reject" → send via send-candidate-email + update stage to rejected
- "Just Reject" → only update stage, no email
- If no email: show warning, only stage update available

### Integration
- CandidateDetailSheet: "Reject with Feedback" button (red/destructive variant)
- KanbanBoard: when dropping to rejected column, add `onRejectCandidate` callback prop. In JobDetailView, wire it to open the dialog instead of immediately changing stage.

## Constraints
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new tables
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- Run `npm run build` — zero errors
